structured.answer: I'd pick ב: each row has the words and the shekel amount together on the right, so on the phone I just read down. Either way the keren is obviously worth it because the employer puts in 54,000 ₪ against my 18,000.

stuck.where: Sentence under the chart: 'אם מושכים עכשיו ושמים את הכסף בחשבון ניירות ערך עד שנה 6: 68,837 ₪, כלומר 15,141 ₪ פחות מאשר לחכות'
stuck.why: 68,837 is more than the 66,513 'נשאר בידיים' next to it, so I couldn't tell what it is 'less' than; I guessed the 83,978. The securities account comparison I came for is only this small sentence, not in the chart.
The amounts are on top and the labels underneath, so I had to look up and down to match them.
Not sure it means what I'd get by waiting one more year without paying in more.

findings.what: Option א keeps the amounts on top and the labels under the bars, so matching them on a phone takes effort; ב puts them together on the right
No colour legend next to the bars; I had to guess what grey, yellow, green and the pink stripes mean
The red striped '−13,974 ₪' is scary and the only explanation of the tax rule is small text above the year bars
The 'מומלץ' tag is on א although ב was easier for me to read
